This is the repository-level analysis index. The site is rendered from
[`_quarto.yml`](_quarto.yml), which is the single source for shared HTML
defaults, publication membership, and the left workflow sidebar. Each analysis
keeps its scientific metadata in its own `analysis.yaml`.

The [MEA parameter bundle](mea_parameter_bundle/notebook.qmd) is the main
parameter-development result. Its overview is the clickable parent page;
formulation, coupled-assessment, and historical-context reports are grouped
under it in the sidebar. The other published pages are reference and decision
evidence that support selecting and assessing the bundle.

## Folder roles for parameter development

The physical folders stay with the result or source owner that created them.
The navigation groups them by the role each record plays in reaching an
accepted parameter suite:

| Navigation group | Folders and purpose |
|:--|:--|
| Parameter bundle | `mea_parameter_bundle/` — current candidate display, formulation studies, coupled assessment, and historical bundle context. This is the only active parameter-development parent. |
| Reference and comparison | `six_species_solubility_reference/`, `neutral_pcsaft_pressure_reference/`, `ideal_reaction_equilibrium/`, and `paper_validation/2015_baygi/` — source-aligned baselines and parity checks used to define or assess candidates. |
| Historical and decision evidence | `historical_fixed_parameter_epcsaft_evaluation/`, `reactive_epcsaft_parameter_evidence/`, and `enrtl_six_species_ideal_comparison/` — completed configurations, packet-specific comparisons, and supported-negative gates. |
| Source and contract records | `film_chemistry_work_package_a/` and `speciation_evidence_harmonization/` — qualified inputs and harmonization work that feed later studies but are not parameter authorities. |
| Retired exploration | `toybox/ionic_parameter_fit_playground/` — rejection receipt only; retain for traceability and exclude from promotion. |

The remaining records are source-contract, reference, or audit analyses without
a hosted report. Their `README.md` and `analysis.yaml` files remain the source
records. Six-species, neutral-pressure, Baygi, speciation-harmonization, film,
and toybox records stay source-only; their values are linked from the pages that
use them rather than copied into new reports.

## Site contract

- Build and host `analyses/_site/` as the single publication target.
- Keep evidence, scripts, and results in the analysis directory that owns them.
- Use page front matter only for content-specific metadata; shared presentation
  belongs in `_quarto.yml`.
- Keep `site.css` limited to the parameter-table and evidence-color rules; the
  cross-page sidebar is native Quarto navigation and the in-page TOC is
  disabled.
- Keep execution disabled for documentation builds. Numerical refreshes remain
  separate analysis commands with their own receipts and claim boundaries.
